name: should show the empty state when the seller has sold nothing under a filter
fullName: SellerOrdersList should show the empty state when the seller has sold nothing under a filter
description:
Seller's sold-orders screens: the list (status chips, rows carrying their status)
and the order detail (waybill + tracking controls, and the outcome of a waybill
download). The Maestro flows in .maestro/flows/orders/seller-*.yaml drive these on
the real QA seller; these tests cover the states that account may not be in.
